name: Abigail & Lumina's Room
body:
Workshop-adjacent with a service stair to the forge below — half studio, half bedroom. Heatproof surfaces meet graceful ribbon storage. One wall holds smithing tools, the other Lumina's dance silks.

ABBI FORGES THE PRACTICAL THINGS — pots, door hinges, utensils, the hooks that hold Lumina's ribbons — AND LUMINA PAINTS THE HANDLES AND TIES THEM WITH BOWS. That sentence is the whole marriage.

Their shared wall calendar is full of hearts marking anniversaries, birthdays and spontaneous date nights written in two different hands. Soot-dark four-poster forged by Abbi's own hands; a smooth wood inset dance-floor strip runs along one side. The room shifts between hammer and pirouette exactly like the women do between strength and silk.
